subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should RFC 0009 establish this full Hosted Feed v1 contract now, including the signed sharding, query, and delta model, or wait for synchronized OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation evidence?
rationale: The patch is a coherent specification change, but it freezes compatibility- and security-sensitive behavior that automation cannot approve from Markdown validation alone.

options.title: Require synchronized contract proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the related implementations share fixtures or live validation proving the specified wire and trust behavior end to end.

options.title: Approve the spec-first contract
options.body: Accept the normative shapes now and explicitly own the risk that open implementations may require later compatibility revisions.

options.title: Narrow to demonstrated behavior
options.body: Merge only corrections already exercised by current implementations and defer sharding, queries, and deltas to a later addendum.

recommendation.title: Require synchronized contract proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the related implementations share fixtures or live validation proving the specified wire and trust behavior end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: They co-authored RFC 0009 and are the strongest available product-direction routing candidate beyond the contributor proposing this revision.
